monsters.name: Aarakocra
monsters.description: Birdlike humanoids that guard the windy borders of the Elemental Plane of Air.

abilities.name: Dive Attack
abilities.description: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage to the target.

abilities.name: Talon
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Aboleth
monsters.description: Before the coming of the gods, aboleths lurked in primordial oceans and underground lakes.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Mucous Cloud
abilities.description: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours.

abilities.name: Probing Telepathy
abilities.description: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.

abilities.name: Tentacle
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Enslave
abilities.description: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth.

abilities.name: Detect
abilities.description: The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

abilities.name: Tail Swipe
abilities.description: The aboleth makes one tail attack.

abilities.name: Psychic Drain
abilities.description: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

abilities.name: Lair Actions
abilities.description: When fighting inside its lair, an aboleth can invoke ambient magic on initiative count 20 to create illusions, water surges, or psychic feedback.

monsters.name: Deva
monsters.description: Angels that act as divine messengers or agents to the Material Plane, Shadowfell, and Feywild.

abilities.name: Angelic Weapons
abilities.description: The deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The deva makes two melee attacks.

abilities.name: Mace
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.description: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

monsters.name: Planetar
monsters.description: Planetars act as the weapons of the gods they serve, presenting a tangible representation of their deities' might.

abilities.name: Angelic Weapons
abilities.description: The planetar's weapon attacks are magical. When the planetar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Divine Awareness
abilities.description: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The planetar makes two melee attacks.

abilities.name: Greatsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.description: The planetar touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

monsters.name: Solar
monsters.description: A solar is godlike in its glory and power, standing at the pinnacle of celestial might.

abilities.name: Angelic Weapons
abilities.description: The solar's weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Divine Awareness
abilities.description: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The solar makes two greatsword attacks.

abilities.name: Greatsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.

abilities.name: Slaying Longbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 120/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If target has 100 HP or fewer, must succeed on DC 15 Con save or die.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: The solar magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

abilities.name: Searing Burst
abilities.description: The solar emits divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a fail, or half on success.

monsters.name: Animated Armor
monsters.description: An empty steel shell clamors as it moves, heavy plates banging and grinding against one another.

abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
abilities.description: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The armor makes two melee attacks.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Flying Sword
monsters.description: A flying sword dances through the air, fighting with the confidence of a warrior that can't be injured.

abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
abilities.description: The sword is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Rug of Smothering
monsters.description: A seemingly ordinary rug that animates to wrap around and smother careless intruders.

abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
abilities.description: The rug is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rug must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Damage Transfer
abilities.description: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

abilities.name: Smother
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating, and the rug can't smother another target. At the start of each of the target's turns, it takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Ankheg
monsters.description: An enormous many-legged insectoid predator that burrows through the earth and sprays acid.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13).

abilities.name: Acid Spray
abilities.description: The ankheg spits acid in a line that is 30 feet long and 5 feet wide, provided that it has no creature grappled. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

monsters.name: Azer
monsters.description: Natives of the Elemental Plane of Fire, azers are master crafters and beings of living fire.

abilities.name: Heated Body
abilities.description: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

abilities.name: Heated Weapons
abilities.description: When the azer hits with a metal melee weapon, it deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.description: The azer sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

abilities.name: Warhammer
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage (or 8 [1d10 + 3] if used with two hands) plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Banshee
monsters.description: Spiteful undead spirits formed from the remnants of female elves who failed to use their beauty to bring joy.

abilities.name: Detect Life
abilities.description: The banshee can magically sense the presence of living creatures up to 5 miles away.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force damage if ending turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Corrupting Touch
abilities.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

abilities.name: Horrifying Visage
abilities.description: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Wail
abilities.description: The banshee releases a mournful wail (not in sunlight). All other creatures within 30 feet that can hear must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On success, takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.description: Reptilian horrors infamous for their supernatural gaze that turns creatures to stone.

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.description: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk and they can see each other, the basilisk can force a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On failure, target begins to turn to stone and is restrained.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

monsters.name: Behir
monsters.description: Serpentine monstrosities with lightning breath and a natural hatred for dragons.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

abilities.name: Lightning Breath
abilities.description: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

abilities.name: Swallow
abilities.description: The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.

monsters.name: Beholder
monsters.description: Hateful, aggressive, and greedy spherical aberrations that dismiss all other creatures as lesser beings.

abilities.name: Antimagic Cone
abilities.description: The beholder's central eye creates an area of antimagic in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the beholder decides which way the cone faces and whether it is active.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Eye Rays
abilities.description: The beholder shoots three magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates) choosing one to three targets within 120 feet (Charm, Paralyzing, Fear, Slowing, Enervation, Telekinetic, Sleep, Petrification, Disintegration, Death rays).

abilities.name: Eye Ray
abilities.description: The beholder uses one random eye ray.

abilities.name: Lair Actions
abilities.description: On initiative count 20, the beholder can cause slime to cover ground (difficult terrain), walls to sprout grasping appendages, or open an eye on a solid surface to fire a random eye ray.

monsters.name: Death Tyrant
monsters.description: A skeletal beholder skull fueled by undeath and negative energy, transforming enemies into zombie servants.

abilities.name: Negative Energy Cone
abilities.description: The death tyrant's central eye emits a 150-foot cone where creatures cannot regain hit points, and humanoids that die become zombies under its command.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Eye Rays
abilities.description: The death tyrant shoots three magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates) choosing one to three targets within 120 feet.

abilities.name: Eye Ray
abilities.description: The death tyrant uses one random eye ray.

monsters.name: Spectator
monsters.description: A lesser four-eyed beholder summoned from another plane to guard locations or treasures.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Eye Rays
abilities.description: The spectator shoots up to two magical eye rays at one or two creatures within 90 feet (Confusion, Paralyzing, Fear, Wounding).

abilities.name: Create Food and Water
abilities.description: The spectator magically creates enough food and water to sustain itself for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Spell Reflection
abilities.description: If the spectator makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses it, the spectator can choose another creature within 30 feet to be targeted by the spell instead.

monsters.name: Twig Blight
monsters.description: An awakened plant that resembles a shambling collection of dead twigs and branches.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead shrub.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Needle Blight
monsters.description: A plant creature covered in sharp wooden needles that it can launch at prey like a volley of arrows.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Needles
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Vine Blight
monsters.description: A slithering plant monster that uses grasping vines to constrict victims and entangle entire areas.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from ordinary vines.

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the blight can't constrict another target.

abilities.name: Entangling Plants
abilities.description: Grasping roots and vines sprout in a 15-foot square centered on a point within 30 feet. Difficult terrain for 1 minute. Creatures in area must make DC 12 Strength saving throw or be restrained.

monsters.name: Bulette
monsters.description: A massive predator known as a land shark that lives only to feed and burrows through the earth.

abilities.name: Standing Leap
abilities.description: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Leap
abilities.description: If the bulette jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage (half on success and pushed 5 ft).

monsters.name: Bullywug
monsters.description: Frog-headed amphibious humanoids that dwell in rainy forests, marshes, and damp caves.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The bullywug can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
abilities.description: The bullywug can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

abilities.name: Swamp Camouflage
abilities.description: The bullywug has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

abilities.name: Standing Leap
abilities.description: The bullywug's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The bullywug makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its spear.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monsters.name: Bugbear
monsters.description: Large, vicious goblinoids born for battle and mayhem that excel at venal ambushes.

abilities.name: Brute
abilities.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Surprise Attack
abilities.description: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

abilities.name: Morningstar
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage in melee or 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage at range.

monsters.name: Bugbear Chief
monsters.description: Fierce war band leaders of the bugbears who rule through strength and brutality.

abilities.name: Brute
abilities.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Heart of Hruggek
abilities.description: The bugbear has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.

abilities.name: Surprise Attack
abilities.description: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The bugbear makes two melee attacks.

abilities.name: Morningstar
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage in melee or 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage at range.

monsters.name: Cambion
monsters.description: Offspring of a fiend and a humanoid that inherit wicked aspects from their otherworldly parentage.

abilities.name: Fiendish Blessing
abilities.description: The AC of the cambion includes its Charisma bonus.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The cambion makes two melee attacks or uses its Fire Ray twice.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Ray
abilities.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Fiendish Charm
abilities.description: One humanoid the cambion can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day.

monsters.name: Carrion Crawler
monsters.description: Wormlike subterranean monstrosities that scour putrid flesh from carcasses and paralyze prey with poison tentacles.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.description: The carrion crawler has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The carrion crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The carrion crawler makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

abilities.name: Tentacles
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Centaur
monsters.description: Reclusive wilderness wanderers and omen-readers that avoid conflict but fight fiercely when pressed.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.

abilities.name: Pike
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Hooves
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Longbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Chimera
monsters.description: Horrific multi-headed monstrosities created by Demogorgon that combine the worst aspects of lion, goat, and dragon.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its horns, and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite or horns.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Horns
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: The dragon head exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Chuul
monsters.description: Crustacean-like aberrations modified by aboleths to serve as tireless guardians and collectors of magic.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The chuul can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Sense Magic
abilities.description: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The chuul makes two pincer attacks. If the chuul is grappling a creature, the chuul can also use its tentacles once.

abilities.name: Pincer
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

abilities.name: Tentacles
abilities.description: One creature grappled by the chuul must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed.

monsters.name: Cloaker
monsters.description: Stealthy subterranean predators resembling dark leather cloaks that wait in shadows to engulf and crush prey.

abilities.name: Damage Transfer
abilities.description: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it, and that creature takes the other half.

abilities.name: Light Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it (blinding and suffocating if attached to the head).

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Moan
abilities.description: Each creature within 60 feet that can hear its moan must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn.

abilities.name: Phantasms
abilities.description: The cloaker magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light.

monsters.name: Cockatrice
monsters.description: A hideous hybrid of lizard, bird, and bat infamous for its ability to turn flesh to stone with a peck.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against being magically petrified.

monsters.name: Couatl
monsters.description: Benevolent serpentine beings of great intellect and insight with brilliantly colored wings.

abilities.name: Magic Weapons
abilities.description: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

abilities.name: Shielded Mind
abilities.description: The couatl is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 24 hours (unconscious while poisoned).

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained.

monsters.name: Crawling Claw
monsters.description: The severed hands of murderers animated by dark magic so that they can go on killing.

abilities.name: Turn Immunity
abilities.description: The claw is immune to effects that turn undead.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning or slashing damage (claw's choice).

monsters.name: Cyclops
monsters.description: One-eyed giants that eke out a meager, reclusive existence in wild lands.

abilities.name: Poor Depth Perception
abilities.description: The cyclops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The cyclops makes two greatclub attacks.

abilities.name: Greatclub
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Rock
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Darkmantle
monsters.description: Cave-dwelling monstrosities that cling to ceilings, dropping down to engulf prey in magical darkness.

abilities.name: Echolocation
abilities.description: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target (blinding and suffocating if attached to the head of a Medium or smaller target).

abilities.name: Darkness Aura
abilities.description: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the darkmantle, moves with it, and spreads around corners. Lasts up to 10 minutes with concentration.

monsters.name: Death Knight
monsters.description: A hateful skeletal warrior clad in plate armor, created when a paladin falls from grace and dies without atonement.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The death knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Marshal Undead
abilities.description: Unless the death knight is incapacitated, it and undead creatures of its choice within 60 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against features that turn undead.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The death knight is a 19th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks).

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The death knight makes three longsword attacks.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

abilities.name: Hellfire Orb
abilities.description: The death knight hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point it can see within 120 feet. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a fail, or half on success.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: The death knight adds 6 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

monsters.name: Demilich
monsters.description: The remaining skull of a lich whose soul and bones have withered into a dangerous, floating remnant of dark power.

abilities.name: Avoidance
abilities.description: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance
abilities.description: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Turn Immunity
abilities.description: The demilich is immune to effects that turn undead.

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.description: The demilich emits a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points (frightened on a success).

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: The demilich targets up to three creatures that it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) necrotic damage, and the demilich regains hit points equal to the total damage dealt.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.description: The demilich flies up to half its flying speed.

abilities.name: Cloud of Dust
abilities.description: The demilich magically swirls its dusty remains, blinding each creature within 10 feet on a failed DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

abilities.name: Energy Drain
abilities.description: Each creature within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, having its hit point maximum reduced by 10 (3d6) on a failure.

abilities.name: Vile Curse
abilities.description: The demilich targets one creature within 30 feet, which must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically cursed with disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

monsters.name: Balor
monsters.description: Figures of ancient and terrible evil that rule as generals over demonic armies.

abilities.name: Death Throes
abilities.description: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a fail, or half on success.

abilities.name: Fire Aura
abilities.description: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. A creature that touches it or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

abilities.name: Whip
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Barlgura
monsters.description: Hulking orangutan-like fiends that represent the savagery and brutality of the Abyss.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.description: At the start of its turn, the barlgura can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Running Leap
abilities.description: The barlgura's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The barlgura makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its fists.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Chasme
monsters.description: Loathsome fly-humanoid demons that use a horrid droning sound to induce lethargy and sleep.

abilities.name: Drone
abilities.description: Any creature starting its turn within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The chasme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without ability checks.

abilities.name: Proboscis
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) necrotic damage, and target's hit point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Dretch
monsters.description: Repulsive, self-loathing lowest demons filled with perpetual discontent and malice.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The dretch makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Fetid Cloud
abilities.description: A 10-foot radius of disgusting green gas extends out. Creatures starting their turn inside must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned.

monsters.name: Glabrezu
monsters.description: Powerful demons that take great pleasure in destroying mortals through temptation and evil bargains.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The glabrezu makes four attacks: two with its pincers and two with its fists. Alternatively, it makes two pincer attacks and casts one spell.

abilities.name: Pincer
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 15).

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Goristro
monsters.description: Towering minotaur-like fiendish living siege engines used by demon lords.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: If the goristro moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and hits with a gore attack, target takes an extra 38 (7d10) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 ft and knocked prone.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.description: The goristro deals double damage to objects and structures.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The goristro makes three attacks: two with its fists and one with its hoof.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Hoof
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (7d10 + 7) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Hezrou
monsters.description: Foul-stenching foot soldiers in the demonic hordes of the Abyss.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Manes
monsters.description: Wretched lowest form of demonkind formed from the souls of evil creatures.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Marilith
monsters.description: Terrifying six-armed demon generals with the lower body of a serpent.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Magic Weapons
abilities.description: The marilith's weapon attacks are magical.

abilities.name: Reactive
abilities.description: The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The marilith makes seven attacks: six with its longswords and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 19) and restrained.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: The marilith magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

monsters.name: Nalfeshnee
monsters.description: Corpulent, grotesque demons with small wings that conceal remarkable intelligence and cunning.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The nalfeshnee uses Horror Nimbus if available, then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Horror Nimbus
abilities.description: The nalfeshnee emits scintillating light. Each creature within 15 feet that can see must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: The nalfeshnee magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Quasit
monsters.description: Small, mischievous demons that infest the Lower Planes and act as spies.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The quasit can use its action to polymorph into a beast form (bat, centipede, toad) or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and target must make a DC 10 Constitution save or take 2d4 poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Scare
abilities.description: One creature of the quasit's choice within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: The quasit magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Scare, or until concentration ends.

monsters.name: Shadow Demon
monsters.description: Insubstantial demon essences resulting from mortal magic that feast on fear and memories.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: The demon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.

abilities.name: Light Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in bright light, the shadow demon has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

abilities.name: Shadow Stealth
abilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow demon can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage if the demon had advantage.

monsters.name: Vrock
monsters.description: Giant vulture-humanoid hybrid demons that live only to create pain and carnage.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The vrock makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

abilities.name: Beak
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Talons
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Spores
abilities.description: A 15-foot-radius cloud of toxic spores extends out. Creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned and take 5 (1d10) poison damage at start of each turn.

abilities.name: Stunning Screech
abilities.description: The vrock emits a horrific screech. Each non-demon within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

monsters.name: Yochlol
monsters.description: Handmaidens of Lolth that act as spies, taskmasters, and agents of villainy.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The yochlol can polymorph into a female drow or giant spider, or back into its true form (pillar of yellow slime).

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The yochlol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without ability checks.

abilities.name: Web Walker
abilities.description: The yochlol ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The yochlol makes two melee attacks.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 ft. in demon form), one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning (or piercing in spider form) damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.

abilities.name: Mist Form
abilities.description: The yochlol transforms into toxic mist or reverts to its true form (flying speed 30 ft, hover, can pass through tight spaces, poisons creatures starting their turn in its space).

monsters.name: Barbed Devil
monsters.description: Greedy devils covered in sharp barbs and spines that act as guards to powerful denizens and vaults.

abilities.name: Barbed Hide
abilities.description: At the start of each of its turns, the barbed devil deals 5 (1d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes three melee attacks: one with its tail and two with its claws. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Flame twice.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Hurl Flame
abilities.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Bearded Devil
monsters.description: Shock troops of the Nine Hells that revel in the glory of battle and wield saw-toothed glaives.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.description: The devil can't be frightened while it can see an allied creature within 30 feet of it.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes two attacks: one with its beard and one with its glaive.

abilities.name: Beard
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, and target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Glaive
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage, and target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or suffer an infernal wound.

monsters.name: Bone Devil
monsters.description: Cruel taskmasters of the Nine Hells with skeletal frames and scorpion tails.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage, and target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Chain Devil
monsters.description: Sadistic jailers and torturers that wear chains like a shroud and animate them to attack.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes two attacks with its chains.

abilities.name: Chain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and target is grappled (escape DC 14).

abilities.name: Animate Chains
abilities.description: Up to four chains the devil can see within 60 feet animate under its control.

abilities.name: Unnerving Mask
abilities.description: When a creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet, the devil can create the illusion of a departed loved one or bitter enemy, forcing a DC 14 Wisdom save or frightened.

monsters.name: Erinyes
monsters.description: Fierce and disciplined warrior devils with large feathery wings that serve as swift punishers.

abilities.name: Hellish Weapons
abilities.description: The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The erinyes makes three attacks.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage (or 9 [1d10 + 4] with two hands) plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

abilities.name: Longbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or be poisoned.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

monsters.name: Horned Devil
monsters.description: Flying infantry of the hellish legions sheathed in iron scales with huge wings and sweeping horns.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes three melee attacks: two with its fork and one with its tail. It can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.

abilities.name: Fork
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage, and target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or suffer an infernal wound.

abilities.name: Hurl Flame
abilities.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Ice Devil
monsters.description: Giant bipedal insectoid commanders of infernal armies on Stygia and Cania.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

abilities.name: Wall of Ice
abilities.description: The devil magically forms an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface within 60 feet.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.description: Diminutive red-skinned devils that run errands, spy, and corrupt mortals.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The imp can polymorph into a beast form (rat, raven, spider) or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and target must make a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a fail, or half on success.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks or concentration ends.

monsters.name: Lemure
monsters.description: Wretched, shapeless lowest form of devil arising from twisted mortal souls banished to the Nine Hells.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the lemure's darkvision.

abilities.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
abilities.description: A lemure that dies in the Nine Hells comes back to life in 1d10 days unless killed by a good-aligned creature with bless or holy water.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Pit Fiend
monsters.description: The undisputed generals of the Nine Hells, ruling over lesser devils as domineering tyrants.

abilities.name: Fear Aura
abilities.description: Any creature hostile to the pit fiend starting its turn within 20 feet must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The pit fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Magic Weapons
abilities.description: The pit fiend's weapon attacks are magical.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The pit fiend makes four attacks: one with its bite, one with its claw, one with its mace, and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage, and target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution save or become poisoned.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Mace
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Spined Devil
monsters.description: Small winged messengers, spies, and flying artillery of the Nine Hells.

abilities.name: Devil's Sight
abilities.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

abilities.name: Flyby
abilities.description: The devil doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The devil makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its fork or two with its tail spines.

abilities.name: Tail Spine
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/80 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Allosaurus
monsters.description: A predatory dinosaur possessing great size, strength, and speed that pounces to pull prey down.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.description: If the allosaurus moves at least 30 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Ankylosaurus
monsters.description: Thick armor-plated herbivorous dinosaur that defends itself with a knobbed tail.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If target is a creature, must succeed on DC 14 Strength save or be knocked prone.

monsters.name: Plesiosaurus
monsters.description: A marine dinosaur with a flexible neck and powerful flippers.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Read Thoughts

abilities.name: Frightful Presence

abilities.name: Lair Actions
abilities.description:
When fighting inside its lair, the dragon can invoke ambient magic on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties) to take one of the following lair actions:
• Pools of water within 120 feet surge outward in a grasping tide. Any creature on the ground within 20 feet of such a pool must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet into the water and knocked prone.
• A cloud of swarming insects fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. Any creature in the cloud must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half on a success.
• Magical darkness spreads from a point within 60 feet, filling a 15-foot-radius sphere.

When fighting inside its lair, the dragon can invoke ambient magic on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties) to take one of the following lair actions:
• Freezing fog fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. Each creature in the fog must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half on a success.
• Jagged ice shards fall from the ceiling, striking up to three creatures underneath within 120 feet (+7 to hit, 10 [3d6] piercing damage).
• The dragon creates an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface within 120 feet (up to 30 ft. long, 30 ft. high, 1 ft. thick).

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.description: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

abilities.name: Shadow Breath
abilities.description: The dragon exhales shadowy fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 71 (13d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies, and an undead shadow rises from its corpse and acts immediately after the dragon in the initiative count under the dragon's control.

abilities.name: Weakening Breath
abilities.description: The dragon exhales gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

abilities.name: Change Shape
abilities.description: The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

abilities.name: Detect
abilities.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

abilities.name: Tail Attack
abilities.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

abilities.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
abilities.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

abilities.name: Lair Actions
abilities.description:
When fighting inside its lair, the dragon can invoke ambient magic on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties) to take one of the following lair actions:
• The dragon glimpses the future, gaining advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until initiative count 20 on the next round.
• One creature within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be banished to a dream plane until initiative count 20 on the next round.

abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw

abilities.description: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Drider
monsters.description: Cursed drow failures transformed by Lolth into towering hybrid spider-humanoids.

abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
abilities.description: The drider has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The drider's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast dancing lights at will, and faerie fire / darkness 1/day each.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The drider makes three attacks: either with its longsword or longbow, or with its bite.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

abilities.name: Longbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

monsters.name: Dryad
monsters.description: Reclusive fey spirits bound to sacred trees that protect woodland groves.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The dryad's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast druidcraft at will, and pass without trace / entangle 3/day each, plus barkskin / druid grove / speak with plants / tree stride.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
abilities.description: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a common language.

abilities.name: Tree Stride
abilities.description: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 5 feet of movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet.

abilities.name: Club
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+5 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

abilities.name: Fey Charm
abilities.description: The dryad targets one humanoid or beast that she can see within 30 feet. If the target can see the dryad, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed.

monsters.name: Duergar
monsters.description: Tyrannical gray dwarves of the Underdark marked by severe demeanor and dark psionic powers.

abilities.name: Dwarven Resilience
abilities.description: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

abilities.name: War Pick
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Ranged or Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

abilities.name: Enlarge

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses Enlarge, or until its concentration ends.

abilities.name: Air Form

abilities.name: Multiattack

abilities.description: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: Multiattack

monsters.name: Flumph

abilities.name: Prone Teleport
abilities.description: If the flumph is knocked prone, it can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.

abilities.name: Tentacles
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

abilities.name: Stink Spray
abilities.description: The flumph sprays a smelly, foul liquid in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be coated in foul stench.

monsters.name: Fomorian

abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.description: The gas spore explodes when it drops to 0 hit points. Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save.

abilities.name: Touch
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract the disease known as Todesepsis.

monsters.name: Shrieker
monsters.description: Mobile-less fungi that emit piercing shrieks when light or creatures approach.

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.description: When any creature is within 30 feet of the shrieker or shines a light on it, the shrieker emits a piercing shriek audible for 300 feet. The shrieker continues to shriek until the disturbance goes away.

monsters.name: Violet Fungus
monsters.description: Treacherous subterranean fungi that lash out with toxic rotting tendrils.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the violet fungus remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

abilities.name: Rotting Touch
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Homunculus
monsters.description: Artificial servants crafted by wizards via dark alchemy to serve as spies and messengers.

abilities.name: Telepathic Link
abilities.description: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically share what it senses with its master.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be poisoned.

monsters.name: Hook Horror
monsters.description: Bizarre subterranean predators bearing hooked appendages and clicking echolocation crests.

abilities.name: Echolocation
abilities.description: The hook horror can't use its blindsight while deafened.

abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
abilities.description: The hook horror can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any hook horror within 100 feet of it.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The hook horror makes two hook attacks.

abilities.name: Hook
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Hydra
monsters.description: Multi-headed serpentine reptilian monstrosities that regenerate severed heads and breathe death.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Multiple Heads
abilities.description: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Invisible Stalker
monsters.description: Relentless air elemental assassins summoned to track and destroy specific targets across planes.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: The stalker is invisibly infused with air, remaining unseen even when it attacks.

abilities.name: Faultless Tracker
abilities.description: The stalker is given a quarry by its summoner. The stalker knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two are on the same plane.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Jackalwere
monsters.description: Malicious shapechangers created by demon lords who lure travelers into lethal ambushes.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The jackalwere can use its action to polymorph into a specific Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid or back into its true form (a jackal).

abilities.name: Bite (Jackal Form)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Sleep Gaze
abilities.description: The jackalwere gazes at one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious.

monsters.name: Intellect Devourer
monsters.description: Malicious brain-like aberrations spawned by illithids that consume intellect and hijack host bodies.

abilities.name: Detect Sentience
abilities.description: The intellect devourer can sense the presence and location of any sentient creature within 300 feet of it, regardless of barriers.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Devour Intellect
abilities.description: The intellect devourer targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw against this magic or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

monsters.name: Kenku
monsters.description: Avian humanoids cursed with flightlessness and speechlessness who communicate through perfect mimicry.

abilities.name: Ambusher
abilities.description: In the first round of combat, the kenku has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.description: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

abilities.name: Shortsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Shortbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Kobold
monsters.description: Cowardly, reptilian humanoids who worship dragons and construct elaborate trap-filled lairs.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

abilities.name: Dagger
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Sling
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Winged Kobold
monsters.description: Rare kobolds blessed with leathery wings who drop stones and crude explosives from above.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

abilities.name: Dagger
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Drop Rock
abilities.description: Drop a rock from midair above a target. Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, one target directly below. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Kraken
monsters.description: Colossal oceanic behemoths worshiped as gods of the deep that command tempests, lightning, and tidal devastation.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The kraken can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
abilities.description: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

abilities.name: Freedom of Movement
abilities.description: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained.

abilities.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
abilities.description: The kraken uses Lightning Storm.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The kraken makes three tentacle attacks, each of which can be replaced by one use of Fling.

abilities.name: Water Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
abilities.description: While underwater, the kraken exhales an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. Each creature in that area has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Tentacle
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

abilities.name: Lightning Storm
abilities.description: The kraken magically conjures three bolts of lightning, striking targets it can see within 120 feet. Each target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Kuo-toa
monsters.description: Deranged, amphibious fish-humanoids of the deep subterranean waters who can manifest gods through raw collective belief.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Otherworldly Perception
abilities.description: The kuo-toa can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible on the Ethereal Plane or hidden.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
