abilities.description: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Kuo-toa Archpriest
monsters.description: Fanatical religious leaders of kuo-toa society who channel divine magic on behalf of mad sovereign deities.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The archpriest is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15).

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The archpriest makes two melee attacks.

abilities.name: Scepter
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

monsters.name: Kuo-toa Whip
monsters.description: Enforcers of kuo-toa archpriests who wield pincer staffs to drag enemies into captivity.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Pincer Staff
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

monsters.name: Lamia
monsters.description: Cursed monstrosities with the upper bodies of human women and the lower bodies of beasts, weaving deceit and dark magic.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The lamia's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast disguise self and major image at will, plus charm person / geas / scrying 1/day each.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The lamia makes two attacks: one with her dagger and one with her touch or two claw attacks.

abilities.name: Dagger
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Intoxicating Touch
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

monsters.name: Lich
monsters.description: Supreme undead spellcasters who have severed ties with mortality through arcane phylacteries to master forbidden magic.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The lich is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).

abilities.name: Paralyzing Touch
abilities.description: Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Cantrip
abilities.description: The lich casts a cantrip.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
abilities.description: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.

abilities.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
abilities.description: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Lizardfolk
monsters.description: Pragmatic reptilian humanoids of warm swamps and marshes who live in harmony with raw wilderness.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its heavy club or two barbed darts.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Club
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Spiked Shield
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Lizardfolk Shaman
monsters.description: Spiritual leaders and druidic spellcasters of lizardfolk tribes who commune with nature and ancestral spirits.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The shaman can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The shaman is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12).

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Totem Staff
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Lizardfolk King/Queen
monsters.description: Supreme tribal monarchs of lizardfolk society who lead with unmatched strength and tactical wisdom.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The monarch can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The monarch makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its greatclub or two javelin attacks.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Greatclub
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Werebear
monsters.description: Solitary, guardian shapechangers who can assume bear or hybrid forms to protect remote wilderness.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The werebear can use its action to polymorph into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid or into a Large bear, or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.description: The werebear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Multiattack (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: In bear form, the werebear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. In hybrid form, it makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one with its bite or claws.

abilities.name: Bite (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Wereboar
monsters.description: Fierce, ill-tempered shapechangers who channel boar savagery into devastating headlong charges.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The wereboar can use its action to polymorph into a Medium boar-humanoid hybrid or into a Medium boar, or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Charge (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: If the wereboar moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with its tusks on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Maul (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Tusks (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Wererat
monsters.description: Cunning, thievish shapechangers who operate criminal syndicates from the shadows of urban sewers.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The wererat can use its action to polymorph into a Medium rat-humanoid hybrid or into a Small giant rat, or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.description: The wererat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Shortsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Weretiger
monsters.description: Proud, solitary hunter shapechangers who stalk tropical jungles and pristine wilderness.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The weretiger can use its action to polymorph into a Large tiger-humanoid hybrid or into a Large tiger, or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
abilities.description: The weretiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

abilities.name: Multiattack (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: In tiger form, the weretiger makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. In hybrid form, it makes two attacks: one with its glaive or bite and one with its claw.

abilities.name: Bite (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Werewolf
monsters.description: Furious pack hunters who unleash bestial fury under the light of a full moon.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a Medium wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a Medium wolf, or back into its true form.

abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
abilities.description: The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

abilities.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Magmin
monsters.description: Fiery elemental spirits born from molten rock and magma that incinerate everything they touch.

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.description: The magmin sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

abilities.name: Melting Touch
abilities.description: The magmin touches a flammable object and it instantly catches fire. If a creature touches the magmin or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Touch
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.description: Monstrous predators with human faces, lion bodies, bat wings, and tails that launch volleys of spikes.

abilities.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
abilities.description: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three tail spike attacks.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Tail Spike
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Medusa
monsters.description: Cursed humanoids with venomous snakes for hair whose petrifying gazes turn living creatures into stone.

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.description: When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the medusa, the medusa can force the creature to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The medusa makes three melee attacks: one with her snake hair, one with her shortsword, and one with her longbow.

abilities.name: Snake Hair
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

abilities.name: Shortsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Longbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

monsters.name: Dust Mephit
monsters.description: Irritating elemental imps composed of dry silt and dust that kick up choking blinding clouds.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Blinding Breath
abilities.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of blinding dust. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Ice Mephit
monsters.description: Frigid elemental imps of ice and frost that breathe chilling shards of frozen wind.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

abilities.name: Frost Breath
abilities.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of frigid air. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) cold damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Magma Mephit
monsters.description: Volcanic elemental imps formed of semi-liquid fire and rock that spit globules of molten lava.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Ooze Mephit
monsters.description: Slime-coated elemental imps composed of viscous muck and foul residue.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.

abilities.name: Acid Breath
abilities.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot line of acidic ooze. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) acid damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Salt Mephit
monsters.description: Brine-encrusted elemental imps composed of crystallized salt that desiccate living targets.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Breath of Dust
abilities.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of crystalline salt. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.

monsters.name: Steam Mephit
monsters.description: Scorching elemental imps of boiling vapor and scalding mist.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Steam Breath
abilities.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Merfolk
monsters.description: Graceful aquatic humanoids with the upper bodies of humans and the tails of fish who inhabit coastal waters.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands.

abilities.name: Heavy Crossbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Merrow
monsters.description: Vicious, mutated aquatic monstrosities corrupted by demonic forces from abyssal depths.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: The merrow can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The merrow makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or harpoon.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Harpoon
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the merrow or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the merrow.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.description: Predatory shapeshifting monstrosities that imitate inanimate objects to ambush unsuspecting prey.

abilities.name: Shapechanger
abilities.description: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

abilities.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
abilities.description: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 13).

abilities.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
abilities.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

abilities.name: Grappler
abilities.description: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has grappled.

abilities.name: Pseudopod
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subject to its Adhesive trait.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

monsters.name: Mind Flayer
monsters.description: Malevolent subterranean aberrations with squid-like heads that feed on the brains of sentient creatures.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The mind flayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
abilities.description: The mind flayer's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast detect thoughts and levitate at will.

abilities.name: Tentacles
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15) and must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned.

abilities.name: Extract Brain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled by the mind flayer. Hit: The target takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the mind flayer kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

abilities.name: Mind Blast
abilities.description: The mind flayer magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.description: Savage, bull-headed humanoids cursed to dwell in labyrinthine mazes where they hunt intruders with relentless fury.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

abilities.name: Labyrinthine Recall
abilities.description: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled, and it can never become lost in any maze or labyrinth.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.description: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until its next turn.

abilities.name: Greataxe
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Monodrone
monsters.description: The lowest-ranking modrons, built to perform a single simple task and report back to superior units.

abilities.name: Axiomatic Mind
abilities.description: The monodrone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

abilities.name: Dagger
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Duodrone
monsters.description: Two-sided box-like modrons tasked with supervising two monodrones or performing dual-step labor.

abilities.name: Axiomatic Mind
abilities.description: The duodrone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The duodrone makes two attacks: one with its fist and one with its javelin or two fist attacks.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Tridrone
monsters.description: Pyramidal three-sided modrons specialized in military squads and mathematical patrol routes.

abilities.name: Axiomatic Mind
abilities.description: The tridrone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The tridrone makes three attacks: one with each of its three fists.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Quadrone
monsters.description: Four-sided cubic modrons equipped with flight capabilities and specialized bow weaponry.

abilities.name: Axiomatic Mind
abilities.description: The quadrone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The quadrone makes four attacks: two with its fists and two with its bow, or four bow attacks.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Bow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Pentadrone
monsters.description: Five-armed star-shaped modrons that serve as law enforcement officers and investigators across Mechanus.

abilities.name: Axiomatic Mind
abilities.description: The pentadrone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The pentadrone makes five arm attacks.

abilities.name: Arm
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Paralytic Gas
abilities.description: The pentadrone exhales a 30-foot cone of gas. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is paralyzed.

monsters.name: Mummy
monsters.description: Preserved corpses bound by dark mortuary rituals and curse-laden wrappings that inflict rotting decay upon the living.

abilities.name: Dreadful Glare
abilities.description: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn.

abilities.name: Rotting Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot.

monsters.name: Mummy Lord
monsters.description: Ancient, pharaonic undead monarchs wielding powerful divine spellcasting and eternal tomb magic.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The mummy lord is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17).

abilities.name: Rotting Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

abilities.name: Blinding Dust (Costs 2 Actions)
abilities.description: The mummy lord magically summons an exploding cloud of sand and ash...

monsters.name: Myconid Sprout
monsters.description: Young ambulatory mushroom humanoids who communicate silently via chemical spores.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sickness
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Moreover, if it starts its turn in sunlight, it takes 1 radiant damage.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.

abilities.name: Pacifying Spores
abilities.description: The myconid ejects spores at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Myconid Sovereign
monsters.description: Ancient, towering fungal rulers of myconid colonies who govern subterranean domains through telepathic spore circles.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sickness
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Moreover, if it starts its turn in sunlight, it takes 5 radiant damage.

abilities.name: Slapping Hand
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

abilities.name: Pacifying Spores
abilities.description: The sovereign erupts spores at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Bone Naga
monsters.description: Skeletal serpent undead crafted from the remains of slain nagas imbued with dark necromantic magic.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The bone naga is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Guardian Naga
monsters.description: Benevolent, feathered serpent protectors of sacred vaults, ancient secrets, and holy temples.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days inside its lair, regaining all its hp.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The guardian naga is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) poison damage.

abilities.name: Spit
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded.

monsters.name: Spirit Naga
monsters.description: Malevolent serpent fiends who cultivate cults of devoted worshipers and guard corrupted sanctuaries.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days inside its lair, regaining all its hp.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The spirit naga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) poison damage.

monsters.name: Nightmare
monsters.description: Malicious equestrian fiends with smoking hooves and fiery manes that gallop through planes and trample the living.

abilities.name: Confer Fire Resistance
abilities.description: The nightmare can grant resistance to fire damage to anyone riding it.

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.description: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

abilities.name: Hooves
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Nothic
monsters.description: Cursed subterranean aberrations bearing a single giant eye that peer into secrets and unhinge minds.

abilities.name: Keen Sight
abilities.description: The nothic has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The nothic makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Rotting Gaze
abilities.description: The nothic targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against this magic or take 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.description: Brutish, foul-tempered giants driven by gluttony, cruelty, and raw destructive urges.

abilities.name: Greatclub
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Oni
monsters.description: Malicious ogre-kin shapechangers who use deceptive illusions to infiltrate mortal settlements and prey upon human flesh.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The oni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast darkness and invisibility at will, plus charm person / cone of cold / gaseous form / sleep 1/day each.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The oni makes two attacks: either with its glaive or its fists.

abilities.name: Glaive
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage in Small or Medium form.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
monsters.description: Transparent cuboidal ooze scavengers that scour dungeon corridors, digesting organic matter and leaving non-digestible treasure suspended.

abilities.name: Ooze Transparent
abilities.description: Even when the cube is completely observant, it is difficult to discern whether a cube is present until it attacks; a creature tries to discern its presence notices it with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check.

abilities.name: Engulf
abilities.description: The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.

abilities.name: Pseudopod
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

monsters.name: Gray Ooze
monsters.description: Deceptive, stone-colored subterranean ooze that corrodes metal weapons and armor upon contact.

abilities.name: Corrode Metal
abilities.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the ooze corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

abilities.name: Pseudopod
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

monsters.name: Ochre Jelly
monsters.description: Yellowish amorphous subterranean jellies that split into smaller copies when struck by lightning or slashing force.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.description: When a jelly that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new jellies if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new jelly has hit points equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down.

abilities.name: Pseudopod
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

monsters.name: Black Pudding
monsters.description: Gluttonous ebony oozes that dissolve flesh, wood, metal, and stone into nutritious sludge.

abilities.name: Corrosive Form
abilities.description: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.description: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points.

abilities.name: Pseudopod
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage.

monsters.name: Orc
monsters.description: Brutal, aggressive humanoids driven by the relentless bloodlust of their one-eyed god Gruumsh.

abilities.name: Aggressive
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

abilities.name: Greataxe
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Orog
monsters.description: Disciplined, heavy-armored orc warriors of superior intelligence who command lesser tribes with brutal tactics.

abilities.name: Aggressive
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the orog can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The orog makes two attacks with its greataxe or its heavy crossbow.

abilities.name: Greataxe
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Orc Eye of Gruumsh
monsters.description: Fanatical, one-eyed orc spellcasters who channel divine wrath and prophecies directly from Gruumsh.

abilities.name: Aggressive
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The orc is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12).

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Orc War Chief
monsters.description: Supreme tribal warlords of orc hordes who inspire savage fanaticism and lead devastating raids.

abilities.name: Aggressive
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

abilities.name: Gruumsh's Fury
abilities.description: The war chief deals an extra 4 (1d8) damage when it hits with a weapon attack (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The war chief makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its hand axe, or two attacks with its spear.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 4 (1d8) damage.

monsters.name: Otyugh
monsters.description: Foul, tentacled subterranean scavengers that consume refuse, dung, and decomposing organic waste.

abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
abilities.description: The otyugh can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand at least one language.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

abilities.name: Tentacle
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

monsters.name: Owlbear
monsters.description: Fierce, aggressive forest predators combining the ferocious traits of giant owls and massive bears.

abilities.name: Keen Sight and Smell
abilities.description: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

abilities.name: Beak
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.description: Magnificent celestial winged horses of the upper planes that embody grace, freedom, and untamed beauty.

abilities.name: Hooves
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Peryton
monsters.description: Vicious hybrid monsters with the bodies of stags and the wings and heads of birds of prey that cast human shadows.

abilities.name: Dive Attack
abilities.description: If the peryton is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage to the target.

abilities.name: Flyby
abilities.description: The peryton doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The peryton makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its talons.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Talons
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Piercer
monsters.description: Deceptive subterranean monstrosities resembling stalactites that drop from cavern ceilings onto passing prey.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the piercer remains motionless on a ceiling, it is indistinguishable from a normal stalactite.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The piercer can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage per 10 feet fallen, up to 30 feet (max 30 damage).

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Pseudodragon
monsters.description: Tiny, cat-sized dragon kin with venomous stingers that frequently serve as loyal wizard familiars.

abilities.name: Keen Senses
abilities.description: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

abilities.name: Limited Telepathy
abilities.description: The pseudodragon can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour.

monsters.name: Purple Worm
monsters.description: Colossal tunneling subterranean monstrosities that devour everything in their path, shaking the earth.

abilities.name: Tunneler
abilities.description: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm.

abilities.name: Tail Stinger
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Quaggoth
monsters.description: Fearsome, fur-covered subterranean humanoids driven into frantic blood-frenzies when wounded.

abilities.name: Wounded Fury
abilities.description: While it has 10 hit points or fewer, the quaggoth has advantage on attack rolls. In addition, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to any target it hits with a melee attack.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The quaggoth makes two claw attacks.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Rakshasa
monsters.description: Devious, tiger-headed fiends wrapped in mortal illusions who orchestrate political intrigue and corruption.

abilities.name: Limited Magic Immunity
abilities.description: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The rakshasa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks).

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The rakshasa makes two attacks: one with its claw and one with its second claw or crossbow.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature.

monsters.name: Remorhaz
monsters.description: Colossal predatory centipedes of polar wastes whose bodies radiate intense blistering heat that melts ice and stone.

abilities.name: Heated Body
abilities.description: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 12 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is swallowed.

monsters.name: Young Remorhaz
monsters.description: Juvenile arctic remorhazes possessing searing body heat and fierce predatory hunger.

abilities.name: Heated Body
abilities.description: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Revenant
monsters.description: Relentless undead spirits driven by boundless vengeance to hunt down those who caused their violent demises.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The revenant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the revenant takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the revenant's next turn.

abilities.name: Vengeful Tracker
abilities.description: The revenant knows the distance to and direction of any creature against which it seeks vengeance, even if the creature and the revenant are on different planes of existence.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The revenant makes two fist attacks.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

monsters.name: Roc
monsters.description: Colossal birds of prey hailing from warm mountains and high peaks that snatch up elephants and ships with ease.

abilities.name: Keen Sight
abilities.description: The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

abilities.name: Beak
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Talons
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the roc can't use its talons on another target.

monsters.name: Roper
monsters.description: Deceptive subterranean horrors resembling stone stalagmites that lash out with sticky tendrils to snare prey.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal stalagmite.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Tendril
abilities.description: The roper targets one creature it can see within 50 feet of it. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled up to 50 feet toward the roper and grappled.

monsters.name: Rust Monster
monsters.description: Bizarre subterranean monstrosities that smell metal and rapidly corrode ferrous weapons, armor, and gear into useless rust.

abilities.name: Rust Metal
abilities.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Antennae
abilities.description: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object within 5 feet of it that is not being worn or carried.

monsters.name: Sahuagin
monsters.description: Vicious, predatory fish-like humanoids known as sea devils that raid coastal settlements and worship shark deities.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

abilities.name: Limited Amphibiousness
abilities.description: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The sahuagin makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Sahuagin Baron
monsters.description: Four-armed warlords and brutal champions of sahuagin society who command legions of sea devils.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: The baron has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

abilities.name: Limited Amphibiousness
abilities.description: The baron can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The baron makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its swords, or four attacks with its trident.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Sahuagin Priestess
monsters.description: Fanatical female religious leaders of sahuagin temples who channel divine shark magic and commune with deep deities.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: The priestess has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

abilities.name: Limited Amphibiousness
abilities.description: The priestess can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: The priestess is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13).

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The priestess makes two attacks: one with her bite and one with her claw or two melee attacks with her light hammer.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Salamander
monsters.description: Malicious serpentine elemental beings of the Elemental Plane of Fire with fiery bodies and metalworking mastery.

abilities.name: Heated Body
abilities.description: A creature that touches the salamander or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Heated Weapons
abilities.description: Any metal melee weapon the salamander wields deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit (included in the attack).

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The salamander makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

monsters.name: Fire Snake
monsters.description: Agile elemental serpents of living flame that serve as scouts and guard hounds for salamanders.

abilities.name: Heated Body
abilities.description: A creature that touches the fire snake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The fire snake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Satyr
monsters.description: Mischievous fey revelers with the upper bodies of humans and the lower bodies of goats who dance through wild forests.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Shortsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Scarecrow
monsters.description: Animated constructs fashioned from straw and rags imbued with dark magic that petrify victims with haunting gazes.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal scarecrow.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The scarecrow makes two claw attacks.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Shadow
monsters.description: Amorphous undead shades that drain the warmth, vitality, and strength from living creatures.

abilities.name: Amorphous
abilities.description: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: Shadow Stealth
abilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Strength Drain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4.

monsters.name: Shambling Mound
monsters.description: Massive, sentient heaps of decomposing plant matter that lurk in swamps and marshes, absorbing and suffocating living prey.

abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
abilities.description: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit against the same target, the target is engulfed.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Shield Guardian
monsters.description: Imposing magical constructs built by spellcasters to protect designated masters and absorb incoming damage.

abilities.name: Bound
abilities.description: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and has its amulet.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The shield guardian makes two fist attacks.

abilities.name: Fist
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.description: Animated skeletal remains reanimated by necromantic magic to serve as mindless undead soldiers.

abilities.name: Shortsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Shortbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Minotaur Skeleton
monsters.description: Massive skeletal remains of a bull-headed monstrosity animated to gore trespassers.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: If the skeleton moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Greataxe
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Warhorse Skeleton
monsters.description: Skeletal remains of heavily armored warhorses reanimated to charge undead cavalries.

abilities.name: Hooves
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Slaad Tadpole
monsters.description: Worm-like chaos spawn that burrow into living hosts to incubate and mature into red or blue slaads.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Red Slaad
monsters.description: Brutish red-scaled entities of raw chaos that infect victims with egg-implanting chaosophages.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws, or three with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Blue Slaad
monsters.description: Fearsome blue-skinned chaotic brutes that infect victims with horrible blue slaad pox.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws, or three with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Green Slaad
monsters.description: Cunning green-skinned slaad spellcasters capable of shapechanging and planting plant-like eggs.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Gray Slaad
monsters.description: Agile and cunning gray slaad warriors wielding greatswords and powerful innate magic.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The slaad makes three attacks: two with its greatsword and one with its bite, or three with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Greatsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Death Slaad
monsters.description: Supreme, scythe-wielding assassins and lords of chaos who command devastating necrotic magic.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The slaad regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or scythe.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Specter
monsters.description: Malevolent incorporeal spirits of the dead filled with bitter hatred and sorrow for the living.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points are reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken.

monsters.name: Androsphinx
monsters.description: Majestic, lion-bodied guardians of sacred tombs and arcane secrets endowed with divine temporal magic.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The androsphinx's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast several divine and arcane spells.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The androsphinx makes two claw attacks.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Gynosphinx
monsters.description: Enigmatic lion-winged scholars of riddles who guard lost knowledge and ancient treasures.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.description: The gynosphinx's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast detect magic, identify, legend lore, and scry.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The gynosphinx makes two claw attacks.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Sprite
monsters.description: Tiny, winged fey guardians of deep forests who wield invisible bows and tiny poisoned needles.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

abilities.name: Shortbow
abilities.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute.

monsters.name: Stirge
monsters.description: Parasitic bat-like blood-sucking pests that latch onto larger creatures to drain their life fluids.

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack, but at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.

monsters.name: Succubus / Incubus
monsters.description: Seductive lower-planar fiends who corrupt mortal souls through temptation, charms, and sweet-tongued deception.

abilities.name: Telepathic Shared Link
abilities.description: The fiend can magically communicate telepathically with any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language.

abilities.name: Claw (Fiend Form)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) psychic damage.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.description: The fiend targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the fiend, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed.

monsters.name: Tarrasque
monsters.description: Legendary, apocalyptic titan of destruction whose awakening spells utter doom for entire worlds.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Reflective Carapace
abilities.description: Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1-5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is swallowed.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Thri-Kreen
monsters.description: Insectoid nomadic hunters of arid wastes equipped with four arms, telepathic bonds, and chitinous carapaces.

abilities.name: Chameleon Carapace
abilities.description: The thri-kreen can change the color of its chitin to match its surroundings, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

abilities.name: Standing Leap
abilities.description: The thri-kreen's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The thri-kreen makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its gythka or chatkcha.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

monsters.name: Treant
monsters.description: Ancient, sentient tree guardians of deep forests that protect woodland flora and awaken lesser trees to fight.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The treant makes two slam attacks.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Troglodyte
monsters.description: Reptilian subterranean humanoids known for their nauseating stench and cruel primitive ambush tactics.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.description: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The troglodyte makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Troll
monsters.description: Vicious, rubbery giant humanoids possessing horrific regenerative powers that only fire and acid can truly halt.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Umber Hulk
monsters.description: Massive, multi-eyed subterranean horrors that tunnel through rock and paralyze prey with hypnotic gazes.

abilities.name: Confusing Gaze
abilities.description: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the umber hulk and is able to see the umber hulk's eyes, the umber hulk can magically force it to make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw.

abilities.name: Tunneler
abilities.description: The umber hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed, leaving a 5-foot-wide, 8-foot-high tunnel in its wake.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The umber hulk makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Unicorn
monsters.description: Magnificent celestial horned equines of pristine grace that dwell in sacred, enchanted forests.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: If the unicorn moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

abilities.name: Hooves
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Horn
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.description: Aristocratic undead lords of the night endowed with shapechanging powers, charm, and immortal bloodlust.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form)
abilities.description: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

abilities.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

abilities.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form)
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Vampire Spawn
monsters.description: Lesser undead thralls created by vampires to guard tombs, hunt prey, and expand their undead bloodlines.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The vampire spawn regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The vampire spawn can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The vampire spawn makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire spawn can grapple the target.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire spawn, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Water Weird
monsters.description: Serpentine elemental guardians composed of living water bound to pools, springs, and sacred bodies of liquid.

abilities.name: Invisible in Water
abilities.description: The water weird is completely invisible while fully immersed in water.

abilities.name: Water Bound
abilities.description: The water weird dies if it leaves the water to which it is bound or if that water is destroyed.

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

monsters.name: Wight
monsters.description: Ambitious undead warriors granted eternal unlife by dark powers to command lesser zombies and skeletons.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The wight makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one sword attack.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced.

abilities.name: Longsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Will-o'-Wisp
monsters.description: Malicious balls of ghostly light that lure travelers into deadly bogs, traps, and hazards to feed on dying anguish.

abilities.name: Ephemeral
abilities.description: The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: The will-o'-wisp can magically turn invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

monsters.name: Wraith
monsters.description: Malicious incorporeal undead wraiths born of hatred that extinguish all life and warmth they encounter.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) necrotic damage, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken.

monsters.name: Wyvern
monsters.description: Fearsome predatory dragon kin with two legs, draconic wings, and a venomous barbed tail stinger.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The wyvern makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger. While flying, it can use its talons in place of one attack.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Stinger
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save.

monsters.name: Xorn
monsters.description: Multilateral elemental beings from the Elemental Plane of Earth that consume precious gems, metals, and stone.

abilities.name: Earth Glide
abilities.description: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

abilities.name: Stone Camouflage
abilities.description: The xorn has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The xorn makes three claw attacks and one bite attack.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Yeti
monsters.description: Fearsome, white-furred ape-like predators of snowy mountain peaks that paralyze prey with freezing gazes.

abilities.name: Chilling Gaze

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The assassin makes two shortsword attacks.

abilities.name: Shortsword
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
